node.title: DLI WCL scope guardrail: the isolated generated-row strengthening is false
node.statement: At the isolated generated C1' row (q,n',N,ell)=(65537,512,256,1), omega=15028 has exact order 512 and 1+omega^95-omega^146=0. This primitive weight-3 relation has a full 512-element signed-shift orbit and first-owner ledger charge 64>1/32. The row satisfies q=1 mod n', 2^N>=q^ell, and N>=16ell, but v_2(q-1)=16<41, so it cannot host the official DLI production tower's ambient top subgroup. Thus WCL-ZONE cannot be extended from official production rows to arbitrary isolated C1' rows.
